display_name.description: Optional human display label for the agent, shown in list views and inherited by resumes that omit it. At most 64 Unicode characters, no control or bidi formatting; null or omission means unnamed.

orchestrator.description: Optional external session binding. transport accepts canonical codex_queue or claude_uds and aliases codex or claude.

name: start

agent_id.description: Stable agent ID returned by start; remains unchanged across resumes.

description: Durably steer an active capable agent.

agent_id.description: Stable agent ID returned by start; remains unchanged across resumes.

name: steer

description: List a bounded page of logical agents with an exact total. Each agent appears once with its stable agent_id and latest execution state; filters and pagination apply to these latest views.

after_message_revision.description: Optional transcript watermark from a prior page's message_revision; journal-only progress (transcript rows, native tool counts) wakes the wait without advancing the event revision. Omission keeps the historical event-only wake.

orchestrator.description: Optional external session filter. transport accepts canonical codex_queue or claude_uds and aliases codex or claude.

name: list_agents

description: Read a bounded cursor page of retained conversation history across all resumes of the stable agent_id. Raw rows remain the default; view=blocks groups only consecutive known native identities. tail_blocks returns the last 1..200 blocks; use previous_cursor as before_cursor for older pages, or next_cursor as cursor for forward pages. Partial blocks and omitted inline content are explicit; raw_ref stays opaque.

agent_id.description: Stable agent ID returned by start; remains unchanged across resumes.

name: transcript

description: Read the latest execution’s verified bounded answer using the stable agent_id. Use transcript for retained earlier conversation history.

agent_id.description: Stable agent ID returned by start; remains unchanged across resumes.

name: answer

description: Continue the latest terminal execution of a stable agent in the same native context. agent_id stays constant. Concurrent continuations cannot create parallel active runs. Reuse request_id for an identical retry, including after later resumes. Identity, permissions, native-history and cleanup checks remain mandatory. Replays are idempotent only with the same nonempty request_id and identical arguments; without a key each call may admit new work.

agent_id.description: Stable agent ID returned by start; remains unchanged across resumes.

display_name.description: Optional replacement display label; omission inherits the previous run's label. Same 64-character control-free bound as start.

orchestrator.description: Optional external session binding. transport accepts canonical codex_queue or claude_uds and aliases codex or claude.

name: resume

description: Read one operator guide topic, or the index when omitted.
name: doc

description: Diagnose stored quota windows, percentages, resets and freshness plus ranked provider/model standing, numeric priorities and provider multipliers from one committed snapshot. Unknown or stale capacity remains explicit; no collection or model turn is started. MCP text omits private account and pool identities. Schema 1 retains its historical quota-window response.
name: limits

description: Before delegating any task, the orchestrator MUST call this tool and read its output before choosing a provider, model, effort, or profile. Do not route from a remembered model list or a separate delegation skill. Returns a compact plain-text guide from current configuration and committed quota observations: providers in capacity order, exact models, quota standing/freshness, admissible profiles, supported parameters, restrictions, and configured recommendations. The orchestrator makes the task-specific choice; the broker selects the account unless explicitly pinned. Follow the start/resume tool contracts for launch, binding, continuation and verified results. Read-only; schema_version 1 is Unsupported. Configured recommendations are guidance, not an automatic model-ability ranking. Optional provider, model and profile filters are exact configured names; unknown names return ValidationError. Omitted filters retain the compact default guide. For optional quota percentages, reset times and numeric priority details, use limits.
name: delegation_guide

acceptance.description: Optional acceptance criteria (1-10); omitted means one criterion for the stated goal.

goal.description: The one common goal, at most 8 KiB.

members.description: Two to five members; each start is an ordinary start request (without request_id or orchestrator) whose task is that member's own responsibility.

existing_agent_id.description: Stable root of a RUNNING independent worker with actual supported private-catalog proof. No restart or deadline extension.

role.description: Descriptive role label, at most 48 characters; it never changes permissions.

display_name.description: Optional human display label for the agent, shown in list views and inherited by resumes that omit it. At most 64 Unicode characters, no control or bidi formatting; null or omission means unnamed.

orchestrator.description: Optional external session binding. transport accepts canonical codex_queue or claude_uds and aliases codex or claude.

request_id.description: Idempotency key; the same key with the same request returns the same pool and agents.

name: start_pool

description: Post one message to every current member of a pool, stamped as from the orchestrator. It may clarify or redirect a member's task but never changes the pool's goal, criteria or any member's permissions. The reply confirms the log entry; delivery to a running member is best-effort and the entry stays readable through pool.

pool_id.description: Stable pool ID returned by start_pool.

name: pool_post

description: Replace one current pool member whose latest execution is terminal and fully cleaned up (cancel it and wait first; an active or uncleaned member is refused as member_busy). The new member keeps the slot, role and name, gets a fresh stable agent_id, the common goal, the current roster and a catch-up instruction, and all earlier votes stop counting. Omitted start reuses the member's original start request (same provider, model, profile and task); an explicit start replaces them under the current catalog and grants. The same request_id returns the same new member.

agent_id.description: Stable agent_id of the current member to replace.

pool_id.description: Stable pool ID returned by start_pool.

display_name.description: Optional human display label for the agent, shown in list views and inherited by resumes that omit it. At most 64 Unicode characters, no control or bidi formatting; null or omission means unnamed.

name: pool_replace

description: Read a pool: its state (open or completed), roster with each member's status, vote validity and cleanup, the current proposal, and a cursor-paged log of stamped entries. Default reads omit the unchanged goal and snapshot except with after_seq 0 or when the proposal is new. Agreement is not completion: the pool completes only after every member succeeded with verified cleanup, and a completed pool's record is frozen. The read-time activity distinguishes running, stopping, cancelled (restorable), settling, needs_action and completed without changing the stored state or frozen proof.

after_seq.description: Entries after this sequence; 0 reads from the start with full context.

before_seq.description: Entries before this positive sequence; exclusive with after_seq.

pool_id.description: Stable pool ID returned by start_pool.

name: pool

description: Discover pools with an exact filtered total, newest-created first. Returns bounded goal excerpts, current member identities and derived ready counts; completed summaries remain frozen. Read-only; no log bodies or criteria.

state.description: Optional lifecycle filter; omission or null selects all pools.

name: list_pools
